name: airk
displayName: AIRK — Artifact Indexing and Retrieval Kernel, the Local MCP Power Tool for Coding Agents
description: Local indexed evidence for coding agents, with a native service, direct MCP retrieval and a shared offline model. No cloud service or API key.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: AIRK starts its native helper and reads workspace files only after you trust the workspace. Until then it registers no MCP servers and refuses indexing, setup and maintenance commands.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with AIRK
walkthroughs.description: Index this workspace locally and give Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI/Antigravity, Copilot or another MCP agent cited evidence from it.

steps.title: Index this workspace
steps.description:
AIRK registers trusted roots with the per-user native service. If needed, use [Manage Workspace Trust](command:workbench.trust.manage). Review the source, collection and separate index storage before registration. Choose manual indexing or automatic watching; native watching continues after editor windows close. [Choose Index Storage Folder](command:airk.chooseStorage) reviews a new storage binding and preserves previous indexes.
[Index Now](command:airk.index)
[Open AIRK Explorer](command:airk.explorer.open) to inspect readiness, native jobs and failures in Management.

media.altText: Saved files become a published index before an agent retrieves evidence.

steps.title: Choose native automatic watching
steps.description:
Choose manual indexing or automatic native watching for the selected project. The native service coalesces source changes and reconciles missed notifications independently of editor windows. Project pause/resume applies across clients.
[Choose Native Automatic Watching](command:airk.indexMode)
The retired editor idle/save timers and soft storage budget do not control native work.

media.altText: Edits are batched into a new published index revision.

steps.title: Connect a coding agent
steps.description:
Choose the agent and review the stable-launcher MCP configuration for this registered project. Recognized legacy Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Antigravity JSON entries have an explicit diff and guarded replacement; existing TOML and other formats use manual merges. Unrelated settings are preserved. Use the agent’s own controls to enable and verify its connection.
[Connect Coding Agent](command:airk.setupAgent)

media.altText: Several coding agents connect to the same workspace-scoped AIRK collection.

steps.title: Verify the connection
steps.description:
Check the native MCP handshake and retained readiness without scheduling indexing, then send the connection guide’s verification prompt in your coding agent. This separate bounded check does not establish the agent’s connection.
[Check AIRK MCP Helper](command:airk.verifyMcp)

media.altText: An agent retrieves bounded evidence from a published local collection.

airk.mcp.responseMode.markdownDescription: MCP response detail. Terse is the default. Choose Full for provenance audits, parser/coverage limitations or missing/surprising results. Reload the MCP connection after changing this setting. Agents can override a single call with `response_mode`.

airk.cli.autoInstall.markdownDescription: Install the native runtime and airk terminal command on trusted activation; register new workspace folders and start automatic indexing. Preserve existing 1.4 storage and watching selections during compatible runtime updates. Adds AIRK to new VS Code terminals and the user PATH (Windows) or Bash, Zsh and fish startup files (macOS/Linux). Restart external terminal applications after installation. Disable in User settings to skip future automatic installation and workspace registration; existing CLI files and PATH entries remain. Use **AIRK: Install or Repair CLI** to retry setup.

airk.service.channel.markdownDescription: Service runtime channel on this execution host. Only user settings are read; workspace values cannot redirect service discovery.

airk.service.installDir.markdownDescription: Absolute user installation directory on this execution host. Empty uses native account defaults. Workspace values are ignored.

airk.service.managedSource.markdownDescription: Absolute organization-provided read-only runtime directory. Requires a separately approved inventory digest. Workspace values are ignored.

airk.service.managedSha256.markdownDescription: Separately supplied SHA-256 approval for the organization runtime inventory. A manifest checksum alone is not approval.

airk.service.managedLifecycle.markdownDescription: Who owns the organization runtime lifetime. External mode disables competing user start, stop and restart.

airk.service.managedStateDir.markdownDescription: Optional absolute writable state directory for the organization runtime. Workspace values are ignored.

airk.explorer.assistance.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable Explorer help and reviewed UI drafts on the unified AIRK MCP connection, and publish this trusted window's private attachment endpoint. Native evidence tools remain available when this is off.

airk.explorer.planner.directory.markdownDescription: Workspace-relative folder that the Planner's save dialog opens in. The dialog always lets you choose another location inside the workspace. `.airk` is excluded from native indexing, so saved plans do not become evidence.

airk.explorer.suggestions.ttlHours.markdownDescription: Hours an agent draft stays in the Explorer Suggestions Inbox before it expires. Drafts are kept in memory for this window only.

airk.explorer.review.testPathPattern.markdownDescription: Regular expression for collection-relative paths that Review › Tests and Review › Impact treat as test files. Matches are candidates; tests are never executed.

airk.mcp.registrationEnabled.markdownDescription: Offer AIRK collections through VS Code's MCP registration provider on this extension host. Turning this off removes automatic definitions and prevents new provider resolutions; use **MCP: List Servers** to manage running connections. It does not pause indexing, remove manual MCP entries or disable external coding agents.

airk.storage.path.markdownDescription: Absolute folder for newly reviewed project index storage on this execution host. Empty uses the native service’s per-user data directory. Only your user setting is read; workspace settings cannot redirect storage. **AIRK: Choose Index Storage Folder…** reviews a fresh native binding. Existing indexes stay owned at their previous locations; the Service Console offers separate unregister and guarded cleanup. Native storage quotas apply to manual and automatic work and are configured through project settings.

scripts.compile: tsc -p . && tsc -p tsconfig.webview.json && tsc -p tsconfig.assistance.json && node scripts/build-explorer.cjs
